test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Kirti, Suman, Shubh, Kanak, Pari, Charu, Shlok and Shivi are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. Kirti sits third to the left of Shubh. Kirti sits at one of the corners. Kanak sits second to the right of Pari. Pari does not sit at any of the corners. Pari is not an immediate neighbour of Kirti. Suman is an immediate neighbour of Charu. Suman does not sit at any of the middle of the sides. Only three people sit between Suman and Shlok from either sides.

Who sits third to the left of Shlok?
solution:
Kirti, Suman, Shubh, Kanak, Pari, Charu, Shlok and Shivi are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners, while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.

1. Kirti sits third to the left of Shubh.

2. Kirti sits at one of the corners.

3. Pari does not sit at any of the corners.

4. Pari is not an immediate neighbour of Kirti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0abde058f60f5d0b9f1852707b713e586922f48713f3b0c68102c4e00e077a4f.png] 

Clearly, there is one possible position which Pari can occupy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f28f06f4eb2d320035d67829ae44bccc4a359215edc2678028d8ca3f8ecdd416.png] 

5. Kanak sits second to the right of Pari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e4945b34a825c92ce6ae1d7814c63aaac20c8db655c14312fb09c42c58a85fc.png] 

6. Suman does not sit at any of the middle of the sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66b541a06bc775e1a041fd9cd14da53dcf7d2c79b324428d3feda21e6630268b.png] 

7. Suman is an immediate neighbour of Charu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58bf13215916cea55e8894c5616216b8e6394955a5a0d1c3e4fc575cb7e1d282.png] 

8. Only three people sit between Suman and Shlok from either sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d06b9a43f0ea21f8d9e3965ca43023d73da0a99aecd93c686c62a12e10812d7.png] 

Shivi, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7ce85a4496cdaa3e93d1b4eb43aed668878a7fe42ef0322bca783554b80c33d.png] 

Clearly, Shubh sits third to the left of Shlok.

Hence, ‘Shubh’ is the correct answer.
